evals.name: matha-concept-scope
evals.prompt: 我高二，準備數A學測。想問：學測數A會考「兩圓的位置關係」嗎？sec、csc 要背嗎？另外三次函數的「對稱中心」跟「在 x=h 附近近似一條直線」我一直搞不懂，學測都怎麼考？講完給我一題練習題。
evals.expected_output: States 兩圓關係 is excluded (G-10-4 備註) and cot/sec/csc are ※ (not tested); explains F-10-2 via f(x)=a(x-h)^3+p(x-h)+k with symmetry centre (h,k) and local line y=p(x-h)+k; cites real past items (e.g. 111數A第10題, 113-3, 114-13, 115-12, 參考試卷第9題); gives one 學測-style practice item with answer and 詳解 separated; replies in 繁體中文.
assertions: States clearly that 兩圓的位置關係 is NOT in 數A 學測 scope
States that sec/csc (and cot) are not tested / outside the exam scope
Explains the symmetry centre using the form a(x−h)^3 + p(x−h) + k (or equivalent) with centre (h, k)
Explains the local linear approximation y = p(x−h) + k near x = h
Cites at least two specific real past 數A questions (year + number) that actually test F-10-2 (valid: 111-10, 113-3, 114-13, 115-12, 參考試卷9, 110試辦8, 考試說明例1)
Includes exactly one practice question with the answer/解析 placed after and separated from the question
The practice question's stated answer is mathematically correct
The whole reply is in 繁體中文

evals.name: science-mock-crossdiscipline-set
evals.prompt: 幫我出一組學測自然第貳部分的跨科題組（物理＋地科），主題跟潮汐或颱風有關都可以，大概4題，要有選擇題也要有非選擇題，附答案、詳解跟評分原則。
evals.expected_output: A 題組 with header like 「37-40題為題組」, a passage with data/table, 4 items mixing 選擇 (with （應選n項） for 多選 and （2分）) and at least one 非選 (4分) with an itemized 評分原則 in official style; 學習內容 codes from both 物理 and 地科 plus 測驗目標; answers correct; labelled as 模擬題.
assertions: Has a 題組 header in official style (e.g. 「37-40題為題組」)
Contains 3–5 items in the set
At least one 多選題 states 「應選 n 項」 and its answer key contains exactly n options
Includes at least one 非選擇題 with a stated point value
The 非選 has an itemized 評分原則 whose points sum to the item's total
Lists 學習內容 codes from both 物理 (P…) and 地球科學 (E…)
Tags 測驗目標 (e.g. 2c, 3b) for the items
All answer keys are scientifically and numerically correct
Labels the items as 模擬題 (not presented as official)

evals.name: matha-grade-113-20
evals.prompt:
幫我照學測評分原則改這題，滿分8分我會拿幾分？哪裡被扣？

題目（113學測數A第20題）：坐標空間中，O為原點，E為平面 x − z = 4。已知空間中一點 P(a, b, c) 滿足向量 OP 與向量 (1,0,0) 的夾角 θ ≤ π/6（第19題已證明此時 a² ≥ 3(b² + c²)）。承19題，已知點 P 在平面 E 上且 b = 0。試求 c 的最大可能範圍，並求線段 OP 的最小可能長度。（非選擇題，8分）

我的作答：
因為 P 在 E 上，所以 a − c = 4，a = c + 4。
b = 0 代入 a² ≥ 3(b² + c²)：(c + 4)² ≥ 3c²
c² + 8c + 16 ≥ 3c²
2c² − 8c − 16 ≤ 0
c² − 4c − 8 ≤ 0，所以 2 − 2√3 ≤ c ≤ 2 + 2√3。
OP² = a² + c² = (c + 4)² + c² = 2c² + 8c + 16 = 2(c + 2)² + 8
所以當 c = −2 時 OP 最小，最小值為 √8 = 2√2。
evals.expected_output: Grades against the official 113 rubric: item 1 (range 2−2√3 ≤ c ≤ 2+2√3) earned; item 2 not earned because c=−2 is outside the range — minimum is at c=2−2√3 giving 4(√3−1); score about 4/8 stated as estimate; quotes student lines; maps the error to F-10-1/F-10-3 (二次函數在區間的極值、範圍檢查) and 測驗目標; gives full-mark writing points.
assertions: Judges the student's range 2−2√3 ≤ c ≤ 2+2√3 as correct
Points out that c = −2 lies outside the allowed range, so the minimum cannot be taken there
Gives the correct minimum OP = 4(√3−1) (or √(64−32√3)) at c = 2−2√3
Gives a total score between 3 and 5 out of 8
Grades against the official 113 評分原則 structure (two scoring items: range; boundary/minimum)
Maps the error to a 學習內容 code (e.g. F-10-1 / F-10-3) or names the 測驗目標
Quotes the student's own lines as evidence

evals.name: science-grade-112-47-and-diagnose
evals.prompt:
這是112學測自然第47題（4分），請依學測評分原則幫我改，然後幫我診斷弱點、給我兩週的加強計畫。

題目：小花根據乳糖發酵生成乳酸的資訊，提出了乳糖發酵的反應式（式1：乳糖 → 乳酸），並測試表8中各種不同的發酵條件對乳酪製作的影響。
表8
組別：甲 乙 丙 丁 戊 己 庚 辛
微生物種類：A B A C A B B A
發酵溫度（℃）：28 32 40 40 28 32 32 28
熟成時間（小時）：24 5 24 24 24 10 12 24
添加食鹽（%）：0.02 0.1 0.1 0.05 0.1 0.1 0.1 0.05
（a）若依照小花的預期，乳糖在水溶液中發酵生成乳酸的化學反應式為何？（各物質須以分子式表示，並以最簡係數平衡）（2分）
（b）若小花想知道熟成時間對乳酪製作的影響，應該挑選表8中哪三組條件下做出的乳酪來作比較？（1分）說明你的根據為何。（1分）

我的作答：
(a) C12H22O11 + H2O → 2 C3H6O3
(b) 選甲、戊、辛，因為它們的微生物都是A、溫度都是28度、熟成時間都是24小時，比較起來最公平。

另外我模考還錯了 111自然第13題 和 115自然第21題。
evals.expected_output: Grades per official 112-47 rubric: (a) species correct but coefficient wrong (should be 4 C3H6O3) → 1/2; (b) wrong groups (should be 乙、己、庚; student's groups hold 熟成時間 constant, varying 食鹽) → 0/2; total 1/4. Diagnoses: CJa-Vc-2 balancing (atom count) and 探究 變因控制 (操縱變因 must differ, others same); identifies 111-13 and 115-21 as 酸鹼指示劑/pH (CJd-Vc-3/4) items; 2-week plan with specific past questions.
assertions: Identifies the correct equation C12H22O11 + H2O → 4 C3H6O3 (coefficient 4, not 2)
Awards 1/2 for part (a) (species correct, coefficients wrong)
Identifies the correct groups 乙、己、庚 for part (b)
Awards 0/2 for part (b)
States a total of 1/4
Correctly identifies 111自然第13題 and 115自然第21題 as 酸鹼指示劑／pH items
Provides a two-week plan that names specific past-paper questions to practise
Maps weaknesses to 學習內容 codes (e.g. CJa-Vc-2, CJd-Vc-3) or 探究與實作 (變因)
